preconditions.description: n and k are positive integers with k less than n and both not exceeding 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output permutation has exactly n elements.
The output permutation contains n distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation)
postconditions.description: Each element in the permutation is a positive integer not larger than n.

postconditions.expression: len(set(abs(permutation[i] - permutation[i + 1]) for i in range(n - 1))) == k
postconditions.description: The number of distinct absolute differences between consecutive elements in the permutation is exactly k.
